Name: amp-brutalist-light-teal
Description: Neo-brutalist light theme with a teal accent. Neo-brutalism is a web design style built on raw, honest shapes: thick black outlines, square corners, solid offset shadows with no blur, flat high-contrast colour and chunky bold type. This version uses lightly tinted paper with white panels, Archivo Black headings, monospace labels and a toy-brick logo, and restyles every AMP screen: instances, status, console, file manager, settings, schedules, backups, store, analytics and login.
Author: Jayden
